kpis.peak_hour_note: KTM Komuter weekday Mon–Fri observed AM peak 07:00–09:00 (24.4%, peak hour 08:00–09:00) & PM peak 18:00–20:00 (23.2%) across 835 weekdays (2023-09-10 to 2026-11-20, MYT). Rapid Rail hourly timestamps are unavailable.

peak_analysis.service_scope: KTM Komuter (hourly OD only; Rapid Rail OD lacks hourly timestamps)
peak_analysis.methodology: Hourly trip totals summed across all OD pairs per cohort and divided strictly by unique observed dates (ISO weekday <= 5 Mon-Fri vs >= 6 Sat-Sun). Peak 2-hour windows maximize consecutive 2-hour mean ridership in AM (05:00-12:00) and PM (15:00-23:00).
